1486-4231-4452-5361--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1479-2841-7885-8098.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Mountain Valley.
[
1479-2841-7885-8098.description:
Fetch a land using Mountain Valley.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2073-6798-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

5231-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5231-7804--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

3510-4094-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3510-4094-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1409-3099-5295-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1251-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3192-5147-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5153-7150-7334.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-7150-7334.description:
Declare The Neutrinos as attackers, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying The Neutrinos's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Neutrinos's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, The Neutrinos and Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger.
Resolve the Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Neutrinos trigger, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-6798-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2034-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2463-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-4094-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4094-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1780-3129.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

147-3269-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3269-5147.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3269-5147.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

2438-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2438-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
2438-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4268-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
4268-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1356-1651-4574-6694-6697.description:
Activate Heart of Ramos by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Heart of Ramos from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Heart of Ramos from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Heart of Ramos from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Heart of Ramos, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

796-1762-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn. 
Repeat.

907-1479-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-4677.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

586-5256-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

659-1753-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-1753-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

311-2292-4424.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
311-2292-4424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Coral Trickster..
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

140-889-2100-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-889-2100-4050.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2501-2539-2712-2934.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with power two or greater.
You have attacked this turn.
You have not cast an instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
Your life total is at least twenty-one.
Your deck size is at least twenty-one.
2501-2539-2712-2934.description:
Cast Howl of the Horde by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater.
Howl of the Horde's casualty ability triggers, creating two copies of it due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Howl of the Horde, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast six times.
Cast Infectious Inquiry by paying {2}{B}.
Each Howl of the Horde triggers, copying Infectious Inquiry a total of nine times due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Infectious Inquiry, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters, and causing you to lose twenty life and draw twenty cards.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1020-2906-3689-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
1020-2906-3689-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying at most {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

649-2506-4659.description:
Cast Corpse Cur.
When Corpse Cur ETBs, Corpse Cur and Molten Echoes trigger.
Allow the Corpse Cur trigger to fizzle.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Corpse Cur.
The token copy of Corpse Cur triggers on ETB, returning the original Corpse Cur to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token copy of Corpse Cur, adding {C}{C} Repeat.

2034-4289-4499-5251-5295.description:
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord for {1}.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap the token creature for {1}.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Emiel the blessed to exile Emmara, Soul of the Accord then return her to the battlefield untapped.
Repeat.
